title: When Copying Is Hard: Copy-Constrained Decoding for Exact Span Reproduction
abstract: arXiv:2610.28393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precisely reproducing a target span verbatim within a long context is a fundamental capability test for LLMs: even when the target string is present in context, models often still drift within the span or fail to stop correctly, revealing limitations in source grounding and boundary control. This capability has broad practical relevance. For instance, code generation often requires embedding sensitive strings such as API keys exactly as they appear in context. In this work, we construct a benchmark to test exact span reproduction ability across contracts, scientific literature, code, and random sequences, and find that current models still make surprisingly frequent errors. To address this, we propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying from a byproduct of next-token prediction into a controlled process. Our key idea is to decompose copying into three distinct decisions: when to copy, how far

translated_title: 当复制变得困难：面向精确片段复现的复制约束解码
translated_abstract: 在长上下文中精确地逐字复现目标片段，是对大语言模型的一项基本能力测试：即使目标字符串就存在于上下文中，模型仍然常常在片段内部发生漂移，或无法正确停止，暴露出其在来源对齐与边界控制方面的局限。这一能力具有广泛的实际意义，例如代码生成往往需要将API密钥等敏感字符串按上下文中出现的原样精确嵌入。在本工作中，我们构建了一个基准，在合同、科学文献、代码和随机序列等场景上测试精确片段复现能力，发现当前模型仍然会犯出人意料地频繁的错误。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CopyGen，一个面向冻结大语言模型的轻量级复制约束插件，它将复制从下一个词预测的副产物转变为一个受控过程。我们的核心思想是将复制分解为三个不同的决策：何时复制、复制多远……
tldr: 该论文提出了CopyGen——一个面向冻结大语言模型的轻量级复制约束解码插件，通过将复制分解为“何时复制、复制多远”等显式决策，显著提升模型在长上下文中精确逐字复现目标片段的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained decoding plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying into a controlled process by decomposing it into explicit decisions of when and how far to copy, substantially improving exact span reproduction in long contexts.
